}}'''High Lord Sunamon''' of [[House Haellin]] is a [[High Lord]] of [[Tear]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is unpleasantly plump and ingratiating.

==History==
He is of House Haellin.{{ref/book|8|24}}{{ref/book|twotc|Sunamon Haellin}}

== Activities ==
He attends a meeting along with High Lords [[Tedosian]], [[Carleon]] and [[Meilan]], in which [[Rand]] discusses lowering taxes, selling grain to Illian and contracting to use Mayene's ships to send the grain.{{ref/book|4|8}}

He consistently undermines and ignores Rand's instructions. He, along with Meilan, presented Rand with their proposed treaty to distribute Tear's excess grain to [[Mayene]], whilst also allowing the presence of two thousand Tairen soldiers under [[Torean]]'s command. Rand burns the proposal and commands them to offer [[Berelain]] a fair treaty directly or be hanged.{{ref/book|4|9}}

He is later one of the High Lords under the command of [[Weiramon]]. He is sent to the [[Plains of Maredo]] where Rand is gathering a massive army for the imminant attack on [[Illian]].

He rides with Rand when Rand's forces attack the invading [[Seanchan]] just outside Illian. He follows [[Gregorin den Lushenos]] into the final assault on the Seanchan.

He leaves with his forces from Illian to return to Tear, against Rand's wishes.
